    - button "Get started with Amazon EC2"

    - heading "What is Amazon EC2?" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) is a cloud computing service that provides resizable, secure compute capacity as virtual servers. It offers over 1,000 instance types across Intel, AMD, and Arm processors and serves developers, enterprises, and teams running web apps, HPC, machine learning, and Windows workloads.
    - button "Play:"
    - img "Missing alt text value"
    - heading "How much does Amazon EC2 cost?" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Try Amazon EC2 for free
    - paragraph: New AWS customers receive up to $200 in AWS Free Tier credits, which can be applied towards eligible AWS services, including Amazon EC2. The free plan is available for 6 months after account creation.
    - paragraph:
      - link "Learn more about the AWS Free Tier":
        - /url: /free/?p=pdp&c=ec2&s=3
    - paragraph: Pay only for the compute you use
    - paragraph: EC2 charges per instance-hour or per second depending on instance type and operating system. On-Demand instances require no upfront commitment. Spot Instances offer up to 90% discount on spare capacity. Savings Plans reduce costs by up to 72% in exchange for a one- or three-year hourly spend commitment.
    - paragraph:
      - link "View detailed pricing":
        - /url: /ec2/pricing/?p=pdp&c=ec2&s=3
    - heading "What problems does Amazon EC2 solve?" [level=2]
    - paragraph
    - heading "Limited processor and instance choice" [level=3]
    - img "aws-library_illustration_expertise_6_1200"
    - text: EC2 runs your workload on the right hardware without locking you into a single processor architecture. It is the first major cloud to support Intel, AMD, and Arm processors, with over 1,000 instance types to match compute, storage, and networking needs.
    - heading "Slow, costly capacity scaling" [level=3]
    - img "aws-library_illustration_growth_1_1200.jpg"
    - text: EC2 scales compute capacity up or down within minutes without physical hardware procurement. It backs infrastructure with an SLA commitment of 99.99% availability, so teams add or remove capacity on demand as workloads shift.
    - heading "High cost for compute-heavy workload" [level=3]
    - img "aws-library_illustration_cloud_2_1200.jpg"
    - text: EC2 optimizes price performance without overpaying for steady or spiky demand. Graviton-based instances, EC2 Spot instances, and AWS Savings Plans give teams flexible purchase models, and C9g instances deliver up to 25% better performance than C8g.
    - heading "Expensive Machine Learning infrastructure" [level=3]
    - img "AWS_Illustration_Prompt_Engineering_2_1200"
    - text: EC2 trains and deploys ML models without settling for slower networking or higher inference cost. It delivers the best price performance for ML training, the lowest cost per inference instances in the cloud, and networking up to 400 Gbps.
